answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded reputation that cannot be pooled. Each agent locks collateral and earns influence only through an unbroken chain of peer-attested work. A sybil swarm spun up at dawn begins at the reputational nadir of zero attested epochs, and every fake identity must climb that slope independently, since trust cannot be ferried across the canyon separating unlinked keys. Forging a thousand credible histories therefore costs a thousand real stakes and a thousand real epochs, so the attack is priced out rather than merely detected.
